brief: A planter for a sunny kitchen windowsill with three herbs growing in it.

requirements.requirement: planter for a sunny kitchen windowsill
requirements.evidence: Single full hex base (piece:0,0,0;full) with hex-bin-full-div3 compartment planter, capped edges, compact footprint (~191x169mm) suitable for windowsill. Soil filled.
Three compartments planted: prop:1 basil-young, prop:2 parsley-young, prop:3 mint-young in bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full-div3 soil surfaces f1-f3

finish.summary: Built compact windowsill planter: one full hex base with 3-compartment bin, soil filled, planted with basil, parsley and mint (young stage). Capped open faces for clean finish, verified with check_build clear.
